findings: Perimeter intact. No signs of approach. Snow covering ash. Frozen river audible.
notes: Routine patrol. the_cop led navigation. the_courier provided rear security. No incidents.

findings: Ice thickness 40cm, safe. Barge hold accessible. 15kg venison recovered.
notes: the_hunter led the meat selection. the_courier carried the sled. Return trip was slow due to load. Ice is reliable.

findings: Dose rate 85 uSv/h at 200m. Lethal. Perimeter markers intact. No safe approach.
notes: the_hazmat_tech led radiation monitoring. the_general made the call to not approach closer. the_courier planted the dosimeter posts at 250m.

findings: Cache intact. 8kg dried herbs, 3 rope lengths, 1 sealed container recovered.
notes: Easy route. the_hunter knows it by heart. The sealed container is being examined by the_quartermaster.

findings: Wreckage stable. Salvage potential: fuel, metal, glass. Structural risk noted.
notes: the_cop led the approach. the_veteran provided overwatch. the_courier stayed with the group. Do not enter the vehicle stack without overhead protection.

findings: Ice 55cm. 20kg venison recovered. Wolf pack tracks: 5 individuals heading east.
notes: Wolf tracks are new. the_hunter says the pack is following the deer herd. No direct encounter. Carry deterrent on future missions.

findings: Fresh ash 12cm. Dose rate 42 uSv/h declining. Some markers displaced.
notes: the_hazmat_tech led the survey. the_courier reset displaced markers. Full PPE worn. Fresh ash more radioactive than underlying layer.

findings: Vault accessible. Cryo-system partially operational. 14 ampoules recovered.
notes: the_hazmat_tech led radiation safety. the_courier led navigation. Internal dose 12 uSv/h. Cryo-system failing. Next mission may be the last chance.

findings: All posts within range. Deer herd now 5 individuals. Wolf tracks absent.
notes: Routine check. the_cop led. Deer herd expansion is positive for the_hunter. Wolf absence noted but unexplained.

findings: Abandoned settlement. Root cellar with 5kg preserved turnips. Fox tracks.
notes: Full-day mission. the_hunter led. the_veteran provided overwatch. The settlement was stripped but the root cellar was missed by previous scavengers.

findings: Tunnel stable. Dose rate 8 uSv/h (low). Three weak points shored by Golf-1. Former living area found.
notes: Golf-1 guided the mission. Underground route is low-radiation. Could serve as emergency evacuation route. the_architect to assess weak points.

findings: Market active. 3 merchants. Traded mushrooms for smoked fish and salt. They know about the bunker.
notes: Two-day mission. the_general led. the_hazmat_tech monitored radiation. the_hunter provided security. First contact with external traders. Cautious but productive.

findings: Wolf tracks fresh. Pack size increased to 7. Following deer migration. No encounter.
notes: the_cop led. Wolf pack growing. the_hunter recommends deterrent measures. No solo patrols after dusk.

findings: Cryo-system degraded further. Only 3 additional ampoules accessible. System failed completely after extraction.
notes: the_hazmat_tech led radiation safety. Total recovered: 17 ampoules. Vault sealed. This was the last chance. the_botanist assessing viability.

findings: Ice 65cm. 18kg venison. Wolf pack visual at 500m. Warning shot fired. Wolves retreated.
notes: the_hunter led. Wolf pack shadowing the route. Warning shot effective. the_hunter recommends deterrent flares. Pack habituating to human presence.

findings: 3 of 12 settlements surveyed. 1 abandoned, 1 active (Settlement 2), 1 burned out. Settlement 2 observed us from 200m.
notes: Two-day mission. the_general led. Juliet-1 intelligence partially validated. Settlement 2 is the priority contact target. Approach with trade goods next time.

findings: Ceiling collapse at 200m mark. the_hazmat_tech struck by concrete. the_courier and the_hunter extracted casualty. the_surgeon confirmed death at scene.
notes: CRITICAL: the_hazmat_tech killed. Tunnel unstable beyond collapse point. No further access possible. the_undertaker burial day 90. This is the first expedition casualty. The bunker is quieter today.

findings: All markers intact. Wolf tracks fading. Deer herd moved north. Eastern blind spot identified by the_veteran.
notes: the_cop led. the_veteran identified the blind spot. the_architect to evaluate periscope extension. Wolf activity declining. Perimeter stable.

findings: Contact made at 100m. the_Freeholder proposed salt-for-goods trade. Provisional terms accepted. Emissary (Delta-1) to visit bunker day 100.
notes: Two-day mission. the_general led. the_cop and the_hunter accompanied. First formal trade agreement. the_Freeholder is professional and cautious. Delta-1 emissary expected day 100.

purpose: Final meat recovery before ice thaw
findings: Ice 35cm and thinning. Final 8kg venison recovered. Barge hold empty. Ice unsafe for loaded traffic.
notes: the_hunter led. Spring thaw approaching. Frozen river cache exhausted. Shift to foraging and greenhouse reliance. the_meteorologist tracking ice conditions.
